copy.blurb: The Market's line on France versus Senegal is already sitting where the model would put it, to within a point on every side. A market this efficient is doing its job: the available information is priced, and there's no slow-moving line for the engine to catch. The model's three-way read — France at 67%, the draw at 16%, Senegal at 17% — tracks the market's shape closely enough that the difference is noise, not edge. Pass is the right call when the price has nothing left to give away. The interesting fixtures are the ones where the line lags; today, this is not one of them.
